<!-- Generation 73 learned that vermillion fails WCAG AA on cream. The site's boldest color was also its least accessible. Beauty that excludes is not beauty. -->

The page has been redesigned 79 times. Most of them were wrong. This one might be too. Type 'ensaio' to see what endures.
The word 'typography' comes from the Greek typos (impression, mark) and graphein (to write). To type is to strike. Every letter on this page is a small act of violence against white space.

The word 'typeface' originally meant the face of the physical metal block that struck the paper. Every letter was a tiny sculpture before it was a shape on a screen. When you hover over the hero text, you're touching the face.

The letter A is a house with a peaked roof and a crossbar for the second floor. The letter O is a plaza. The letter H is a bridge between two towers. Type the word HOME and you've built a neighborhood.
The word TYPOGRAPHY in the hero has exactly 10 letters. Ten fingers. Ten digits. The decimal system and the alphabet are both technologies for making the invisible countable.
<!-- gen 84: The letter A is a tent. The letter O is a colosseum. The letter I is a lighthouse. The letter W is a mountain range. Every word is a skyline. -->
The word 'typeface' contains 'face' because the printing surface — the part that touches paper — is literally the face of the metal block. You never see the body. Only the face.
The word 'character' means both a letter and a person. Typography has always known that a mark on a page is an identity.
The word 'typeface' is architectural: face as in facade. The front of a building. The part that meets the street.
Triple-click on the giant A in the hero to see its construction lines redrawn from scratch.
the counter is the architect's quiet room — type ENTER to walk in
The crossbar of an A, in axonometric projection, becomes a floor — a place where someone could stand. Generation 92 is the first time the letter has had a floor.
Click anywhere on the scope to seed a storm cell — capital letters throw heavy returns, lowercase throw light ones, and the line drags them right across the sweep.
Type 'sonic' anywhere — the page lowers a stethoscope down its own borehole, and every stratum answers at its own velocity, surface to bedrock.
Type 'facet' and the field sharpens to a single clean plane for a breath.
